title: Finite Contact Theory v0.2: Behavior-Conditioned Contextual Capacity and an Exact Strict Preparation Gap
description: A finite reconstruction program for admissible reality, starting below spacetime, probability, observers, Hilbert space, and the completed continuum. This v0.2 chapter, written in standard quantum-foundations language, defines the behavior-conditioned contextual capacity kappa_G(p) - the least operator-norm capacity any sharp quantum model must carry to reproduce a fixed exclusivity-graph behavior - and the preparation gap Delta_prep = kappa - beta. It proves the universal inequality, a faithful Gram-fiber SDP reduction with a rank-one compression theorem, a headroom law making the gap an operational re-preparation resource, the pentagon tightness phase geometry, and, as the centerpiece, an exact strict-gap certificate: an explicit rational KCBS-pentagon behavior whose every sharp realization in every finite dimension carries capacity strictly above beta, verified end to end in exact rational arithmetic by a shipped dependency-free script. The novelty claim is graded at INTERNAL-BLIND evidence class with published searches and named nearest precedents. The v0.1 binary-Bell quantum-boundary chapter is unchanged; every unearned generalization - general-graph phase geometry, the robust asymmetry bridge, the general quantum selector, gravity sourcing, and nature-facing predictions - is held open by name.
